description: This file defines and manages plugin SDK facade modules for different plugins/subpaths, including functions to generate module import code, resolve export kinds, and produce type maps. It handles dynamic loading strategies and type exports for a plugin SDK system.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates the module code for a plugin facade entry, including dynamic import loaders, export mappings, and type exports based on the source file and its export kinds.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript interface mapping plugin subpaths to their imported modules and types, used for type safety and dynamic loading.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Parses a runtime API source file to extract exported symbols, particularly for the line runtime API.
